description:
sieve_admin.rs contains a user_exists function that only checks whether the username equals GLOBAL_SCRIPT_KEY (a single constant). It does not query the credential store or any user database. Any request for a per-user script under a name that is not the global key will be rejected as 'user not found', making per-user Sieve scripts impossible to manage via the admin API.

The function name 'user_exists' implies a real user lookup, making the intent unclear to maintainers. If per-user script management is intentionally out of scope for v1, the function should be removed and the check should be inlined and clearly commented. If per-user management is intended, the function must query the actual user store.

Fix: either inline the GLOBAL_SCRIPT_KEY comparison with a comment explaining it is intentionally the only supported key, or wire user_exists to the AuthConfig credential store.
title: smtp: user_exists in sieve_admin checks global key, not real users
